scientific.integrity: The proof diagonalizes the SPD quadratic and applies the exact degree-two Schur criterion to each Grokfast-EMA mode. The resulting boundary is independently identified with the source EMA filter gain at Nyquist frequency.
limitations: Plain gradient descent is the base optimizer.
The objective is deterministic, quadratic, and SPD.
The learning rate and filter parameters are constant.
The theorem concerns asymptotic stability rather than per-step descent or grokking itself.

title: Exact Nyquist-gain stability law for Grokfast-EMA gradient descent
